The accuracy is the per-question count and **not** `costEfficiency.accuracy` 0.9125: that field divides 1,825 correct verdicts by 2,000 (four passes), while every competitor row here is a single pass over 500 questions (§172.5). Rows without a token count did not publish one. Self-reported accuracy is not comparable across rows -- the answer model alone moves Mastra from 84.23 to 94.87 -- which is why the cost axis is plotted rather than trusted alone.
